passed_checks: Funding goals align with the stated cell-architecture and biomedical AI purposes.
The description, instances and intended uses describe compatible modalities and biological conditions.
CC BY-NC-SA terms agree with the no-commercial-use permission and separate commercial-license negotiation.
Commercial de-identified tissue-culture origins are compatible with the stated absence of human-subject research.
The latest-release DOI agrees across version_access, the matching component and the distribution access URL.
Reuse licensing is accompanied by documented distribution formats.
warning_checks: Deidentification declarations are not accompanied by comprehensive privacy-risk and safeguard documentation.
Public archive labels and embargoed underlying data do not fully resolve access authorization steps.
Source release dates and project-end dates require the distinctions already recorded in source_caveats.
Undated website counts and availability labels cannot be treated as measurements of the current release.

correctness_validations.doi_format: The supplied 10.18130/V3/... release DOIs and 10.1101/... publication DOIs are structurally plausible. The release identifiers are consistently associated with University of Virginia Dataverse. Resolution was not tested.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: The three NIH award strings have plausible OT2 or U54 activity codes, institute codes, serial numbers and support-year or supplement suffixes.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: RRID:CVCL_0419 and RRID:CVCL_B5P3 do not match the instrument's stated SCR/AB patterns. They use the cell-line CVCL namespace; the pattern mismatch alone does not establish incorrect identifiers and causes no score deduction.
correctness_validations.url_validity: The supplied HTTPS URLs have plausible syntax and domains. No network requests or external validity checks were performed.

issues_detected.description: The record discloses a website release-year discrepancy and differing project-end statements. It selects the Dataverse release date and preserves the distinct maintenance and award dates with attribution.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain these source distinctions and reconcile them if authoritative clarifications become available.

semantic_insights: The record clearly defines the root as a release series and preserves component release metadata at its actual location.
Source caveats distinguish current-release statements, earlier-release methods, preprint claims and undated website statistics.
Funding attribution distinguishes direct project awards from support acknowledged only in the preprint.
The documentation consistently distinguishes released measurement data from computed cell maps that are not yet included.
Nonclinical human-cell-line origins are compatible with the record's non-human-subject-research declaration; this does not override the caller's unknown applicability context.
Rounded file sizes, public archive listings, embargoed data links and noncommercial reuse restrictions are meaningfully distinguished.
